  "description": "Read-only access to the agentcensus adoption census. · Current adoption figures with their denominator. · Adoption of each discovery mechanism over a window, with errors reported separately from misses. · Which discovery label publishers actually use - the drafts disagree, so this is the split. The variants overlap and do not sum. · What the census has observed for one registrable domain. · Search every agent and MCP server the census has discovered, ranked by relevance. What each agent publishes goes to anyone; what the census observed needs a key. · Your own organisation's API usage against its daily quota - what the console's usage page shows. Needs your signed-in session's bearer token; exactly what that session already sees, and nothing without one. · Your own organisation's domain claims and their verification state - what the console's domains page shows. Needs your signed-in session's bearer token; what that session already sees, less who made each claim (member identities are withheld, ADR-052 §6), and nothing without one. · Your own organisation's alert rules and when each last fired - the rule list on the console's alerts page.
